name: Enterprise Operations & Financial Advisory
description: Operational diagnostics, inventory stockout forecasting, working capital optimization, and supply chain risk mitigation.
target_persona: Operations Manager, CFO, or Small Business Owner
analysis_focus: Detect discrepancies between projected and actual turnover rates
Identify cash burn rates and short-term liquidity bottlenecks
Assess supplier dependability and logistics choke points

risk_rules.warning: Imminent liquidity crisis; operating expenses will exceed cash reserves.
Inventory depletion expected before replenishment arrival, causing lost revenue.
Rising COGS eroding gross margins without compensatory price elasticity.

recommendation_types: Working capital preservation and invoice factoring
Dynamic safety stock recalculation and multi-sourcing PO triggers
Cost containment on non-critical operating expenditures
disclaimer: Advisory metrics are calculated for tactical decision support and do not constitute formal financial audit or fiduciary counsel.
